03 — A supportive, high-performing team We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — every one, on top of base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month

The status bonus — how it works: Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads. Hit 12 = 10%, 16 = 15%, 20 = 20%. The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level that's an extra ~$375/mo. At Gold level an extra $1,250/mo — all on top of your base and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00am – 5:30pm Eastern Time (ET) That is 10:00pm – 6:30am Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, the process — until you feel fully confident. To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work

Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, managing your pipeline

What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.



Ready to apply? If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with a brief introduction and any relevant experience you'd like to share.

ed instructions from our California team and ensuring it is accurately entered into our CRM. You will be explicitly trained on our standards and procedures ("the GraphicLab way") by our lead VA.

 and social media outreach campaigns using CRM/customer data to help us re-engage past customers and generate new leads.

 + Social Campaign Support (Slow-Season Outreach):

Build and send
 campaigns (subject lines, copy, basic layout) to re-engage customers and drive quote requests.

Schedule posts and coordinate a simple content calendar.



Track and report results (what was sent/posted, opens/clicks/replies, what to improve next round).



REQUIREMENTS

Industry Experience: Knowledge of the Beverage Industry is highly important. Experience in the Promotional Products / Apparel industry is ideal. Having experience in both is considered a massive plus.



Communication Style (Crucial): You must be a loud, clear, and confident communicator; therefore, candidates who are soft-spoken or meek will not be a good fit.



Shift Requirement: You must be available to work a strict 40-hour week on the US Pacific Standard Time (PST) schedule to entirely overlap with our California office. Note: Hours are strictly capped at 40 per week and cannot be exceeded unless requested in writing.



lawless English (Written and Spoken): You must be able to write clear, professional
s and CRM communications. You will attend virtual meetings with our internal team and occasionally with our customers.



Attention to Detail: You must be highly diligent; a single typo in a SKU number or choosing the wrong color can cost the company money. Accuracy is paramount.



Tech-Savvy: Familiarity with CRM systems is a plus, but a strong general ability to learn new software quickly is required (MS Office, Google Workspace, Adobe, etc.).

Submit your resume.

If a vendor

During a slow week, you’re asked to re-engage past customers. What CRM info would you pull, and what would your first

**DO NOT APPLY unless you can work eastern time US**



We are an active residential developer and construction company based in the Northeast U.S. We build and sell homes. 



You must understand how money moves through a development deal — from land acquisition through construction draws to closing. If you've never worked with a builder, developer, or construction company, do not apply.



**This role requires judgment on:**

- Job costing across multiple active construction projects

- Construction draw reconciliation and lender reporting

- Capitalizing hard and soft costs into the basis of each property

- Correctly booking land acquisition, closing costs, and carrying costs

- Revenue recognition on home sales and lot closings

- Accounts payable across multiple vendor relationships and entities

- Tracking costs by project across multiple LLCs simultaneously

- Distinguishing between operating expenses and project costs



**Mandatory application test:**

- How do you track construction costs across multiple projects in QuickBooks?

- What costs get capitalized into the basis of a property under development?

- How do you handle a draw request from a lender — what does the accounting look like?

- How do you book the sale of a newly constructed home?

- How do you manage AP across multiple entity LLCs with shared vendors?



**We will reject applicants who:**

- Have never worked with a builder or developer

- Cannot explain job costing

- Don't understand construction draws

- Send generic responses



**Position details:**

- Remote

- Full time

- Must overlap U.S. Eastern Time

- Pay based on proven skill and experience



**Final note:**

This role sits between bookkeeper and controller. You'll be working directly with ownership across active construction projects. If you're sharp, organized, and understand how development deals work financially, we pay well and we're a long term opportunity.

title: Google Ads Strategic Consultant
description:
I am looking for a high-level Google Ads expert for a part-time, advisory-heavy role. The goal is to move past basic execution and focus on advanced strategy, technical architecture, and ROI-driven optimization. I am looking for a partner to help build the account correctly and provide ongoing strategic insights.



Required Experience & Strategic Knowledge

The ideal candidate must demonstrate a deep understanding of:



-Advanced Conversion Architecture: Expertise in $GTM$ (Google Tag Manager) and $GA4$ server-side tracking. You should know how to track the entire funnel, not just "button clicks."

-Mathematical Bidding Strategies: Experience managing the transition from Manual CPC to automated strategies ($tCPA$ / $tROAS$) and knowing exactly when the data "signals" are strong enough to make that switch.

-Quality Score Engineering: A proven methodology for improving Ad Relevance and Landing Page Experience to drive down the actual $CPC$ (Cost Per Click).

-Attribution Modeling: Knowledge of how Google Ads interacts with other channels and how to interpret "Data-Driven Attribution" to see the true path to conversion.

-Competitive Intelligence: Ability to use Auction Insights and third-party tools to reverse-engineer competitor budgets and keyword gaps.

-Landing Page Optimization (LPO): Ability to provide strategic feedback on UI/UX and copy to ensure traffic actually converts once it hits the site.



Collaboration Style

-Insight-Led: You are expected to explain the "Why" behind the data, not just report the "What."

-Flexible/Consultative: This is a part-time arrangement. I am looking for someone available for 2–5 hours per week for audits, strategic pivots, and high-level management.

-Business-Centric: You understand that a "successful" campaign is measured by profit margins and $LTV$ (Lifetime Value), not just click-through rates.

title: Manager, Billing & Financial Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.



This is a 1st-line management role for a detail-obsessed, process-driven leader who has run billing and collections teams before. You are not just doing the work — you are building the systems, the SOPs, and the team discipline that make the work run without constant supervision. You manage the specialists; you own the numbers; you report up to leadership with clean, confident data.



Key Responsibilities:

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Own end-to-end billing operations — from invoice generation through delivery, dispute resolution, and closed-loop reconciliation across all MedPro and MP1 service lines

• Oversee accurate and timely processing of all financial transactions: vendor payables, service billings, manifest entries, client invoices, and payment applications

• Ensure all billing records align with service agreements, contracts, and pricing structures — identifying and correcting discrepancies before they reach the client or vendor

• Manage the billing cycle calendar: maintain a disciplined, predictable cadence for invoice runs, payment postings, and month-end closes

• Build and enforce quality controls that reduce error rates, prevent duplicate payments, and maintain clean accounts across all transaction types

Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

• Own the collections process: proactively work aging receivables, contact clients with outstanding balances through defined outreach workflows, and escalate chronic non-payers through the appropriate path

• Maintain current and accurate AR aging reports — tracking open balances, days sales outstanding (DSO), and collection trends with weekly reporting to leadership

• Resolve billing disputes and discrepancies with professionalism and speed — balancing firmness in collections with the client relationship standards MedPro and MP1 are built on

• Identify and flag accounts at risk; recommend credit holds, payment plans, or escalation paths in partnership with leadership

• Ensure all collections activity is documented, auditable, and compliant with applicable regulations

Accounts Payable & Vendor Payments

• Manage the accounts payable function — ensure all vendor invoices are received, approved, accurately coded, and paid on schedule

• Maintain the vendor master list; manage vendor relationships for routine billing and payment inquiries

• Reconcile AP aging reports, resolve vendor disputes, and ensure no invoices age beyond terms without documented reason

We are a digital health platform delivering AI-driven music therapy solutions to nursing home facilities across the United States. • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and provide post-migration support documentation.

• Collaborate closely with engineering and DevOps teams throughout the migration process.



Current GCP Stack

• Cloud Run

• Pub/Sub

• Cloud SQL MySQL

• Memorystore Redis

• Secret Manager

• Cloud Storage

• IAM



Target Azure Stack

• Azure Container Apps or AKS

• Azure Service Bus

• Azure Database for MySQL

• Azure Cache for Redis

• Azure Key Vault

• Azure Blob Storage

• Entra ID / RBAC



Must-Have Requirements

• Proven production-level GCP ? Azure migration experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with:

o Azure Container Apps or AKS

o Azure Service Bus

o Azure Database for MySQL

o Azure Cache for Redis

o Azure Key Vault

• Experience working with containerized NestJS/TypeScript and Python FastAPI services.

• Strong MySQL operational knowledge including replication, backup/restore, and cross-cloud migration.

• Solid networking fundamentals including VNets, private endpoints, DNS, and egress control.

• Comfortable working directly with cloud CLI tools (gcloud and az).

• Strong documentation and communication skills for architecture mapping and knowledge transfer.



Nice-to-Have

• DevOps/SRE background.

• Experience supporting healthcare or HIPAA-adjacent platforms.

• Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code tooling.

title: Podcast Producer & Video Editor (Transistor.fm Expert)
description:

Your Responsibilities

• Maintain a flawless, organized file/version system and participate in daily check-ins and weekly feedback calls



Requirements



• Hands-on Transistor.fm experience is required (You have actively published, scheduled, and managed multi-show workspaces or private feeds on the platform)

• Proven podcast video and audio editing experience (You must bring 2–3 full episodes you have personally edited)

• Proficiency with at least one major DAW (Adobe Audition, Logic, Pro Tools, or similar)

• Strong video editing software skills (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro)

• Motion graphics experience (After Effects) and graphic design skills for thumbnails

• A sharp eye for hook timing, short-form pacing, and platform-native trends

• Strong written English for writing clear clip titles, show notes, and error-free captions

• Detail-oriented and capable of following strict brand guidelines precisely



To Apply

Your application must include:

title: Healthcare Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
We're looking for a Health Care Talent Acquisition Coordinator with a recruiting or HR background to fully own the pipeline for a fast-growing AI healthcare startup. This role is built for someone who already knows how to manage a high-volume funnel, keep job boards running cleanly, and hit a consistent hiring target without needing process built for them.



The goal is four qualified hires every two weeks, aligned to a biweekly training cycle. You own that number. If you have managed volume recruiting before, know how to clear an inbox of hundreds of applications efficiently, and can run independently across time zones, this role is a strong fit.



Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

- Direct ownership over a high-volume recruiting function with clear weekly targets

- Work inside a growing healthtech startup where your hiring output directly drives the business



What You'll Work On



Full-Cycle Recruiting Pipeline



- Actively source and move candidates through the funnel across multiple job boards with hundreds of applications weekly

- Review inbound applications same-day or next-day across all active platforms

- Screen candidates and advance qualified applicants without waiting for direction

- Hit a consistent target of four qualified hires per two-week training cycle



Interview Scheduling and Coordination



- Schedule all interview rounds with enough lead time to ensure a professional candidate experience

- Send calendar invites at least 24 hours in advance across all interview stages

- Coordinate availability between candidates and internal interviewers without friction



Job Posting and Pipeline Management



- Refine, publish, and actively iterate job descriptions based on performance data and feedback

- Manage active postings across Indeed and other relevant job boards

- Keep the pipeline clean, organized, and moving at all times



Onboarding and Training Support



- Ensure new hires are fully set up on all required tools and systems before day one

- Complete onboarding training yourself, then assist in delivering sessions and developing materials for new hires

- Flag setup gaps or blockers early so nothing falls through on the first day



What You Bring



- 2+ years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or HR coordination

- Proven experience managing high-volume application pipelines across job boards including Indeed or similar platforms

- Strong written English communication skills: clear, direct, and professional

- Demonstrated ability to work independently across time zones with minimal oversight

- High attention to detail and consistent follow-through without reminders

- Ownership mindset: you surface problems with a proposed solution, not just a flag

- Comfort owning a weekly hiring metric and being accountable to it



## Nice to Have



- Experience in healthcare, healthtech, or clinical staffing environments

- Familiarity with high-volume hourly or specialist hiring

- Prior experience managing or training new hires

- Interest in AI tools that could streamline or automate parts of the recruiting workflow



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your updated resume

2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience managing a high-volume recruiting pipeline, and sharing one example of a problem you identified and solved independently without being asked



Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.



If you are a self-directed recruiter who can own a full hiring pipeline, hit a consistent weekly target, and wants to do meaningful work inside a company removing real friction from healthcare, this role gives you the ownership and the impact to do your best work.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant

Fully Remote, Part-Time



ABOUT YOU

You have a refining nature that is always looking for how to make things a little bit better. You notice the small things like a repeating conversation, a habit people fall into, or an unnoticed shortcut. You adapt or suggest changes to others, so those patterns become opportunities for growth.



You care about doing things intentionally. You think things through, break them down clearly, notice details others miss, and bring a sense of order to what you take on.



You’re naturally curious... the kind of person who wants to understand how things work and why something is the way it is. You look for context, ask clarifying questions, and enjoy figuring things out until the “why” becomes clear.



You move through life with a deep belief that everything is for your good. You don’t see challenges as setbacks, you see them as a puzzle to solve, a lesson to learn, or an opportunity for growth. At your core, you’re a glass-half-full person.

Our team is fully remote, but our impact is nationwide — and we’re growing quickly.

If you’ve personally made offers to sellers and closed contracts over the phone, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work in a high-energy, professional environment.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions (+Bonuses!)
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



About Us

Price Real Estate Investments is a multi-market U.S. based real estate investment company focused on acquiring off-market properties directly from homeowners. We specialize in building strong relationships with sellers, negotiating with them, and closing deals virtually. Our team is fully remote, but our impact is nationwide — and we’re growing quickly.



We’re looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist to join our acquisitions team. This role is critical to our business: you’ll be speaking directly with homeowners, negotiating terms, and guiding sellers through the contract signing process. If you’ve personally made offers to sellers and closed contracts over the phone, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work in a high-energy, professional environment.



Compensation

$10/hour USD base pay



Plus Monthly Contract Bonuses for getting offers accepted:

• Bronze: 2 signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 signed contracts = $1,000 bonus

• Gold: 4 signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Platinum: 5+ signed contracts = $2,000 bonus



On-target earnings can range from $2,500–$3,500+ per month depending on performance. Pay dates are on the 1st and 15th of each month.



We believe in rewarding results. Our top performers earn meaningful bonuses based on closed contracts and consistent production.



Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST

Remote position, work from your own secure setup



What You’ll Be Doing

- Engage with homeowners (seller leads), build authentic rapport, and manage conversations with professionalism

- Follow a proven acquisitions script while sounding natural and confident

- Ask strong follow-up questions to uncover seller motivation and property condition

- Make verbal offers, negotiate price and terms, and walk sellers through agreements using DocuSign

- Handle objections effectively and push deals forward toward signed contracts

- Maintain organized notes, offers, and seller updates in our CRM

- Collaborate closely with the acquisitions team and leadership



What It Takes to Succeed Here

- Relentless Follow-Up: Sellers don’t always respond the first time — or the second. You know how to stay persistent with calls, texts, and follow-ups until you get an answer. Nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

- Extreme Attention to Detail: Every call, every note, every update gets logged correctly in the CRM. You don’t miss details, and you take pride in keeping your pipeline organized. If you’ve ever been called meticulous or “on top of everything,” this is where you’ll shine.

- Closer’s Mentality: You’re not just reading a script — you know how to listen, build rapport, and guide sellers toward a decision. You thrive on negotiation, handle objections with confidence, and create win-win agreements that get signed.

- Driven by Results: You measure success by contracts closed. You hold yourself to high standards and push to hit — and exceed — your targets consistently. You’re motivated by performance and driven by the satisfaction of closing successful deals.

- Resilient Problem-Solver: Whether it’s a tough seller, a pricing objection, or a complicated situation, you don’t freeze — you find solutions and move the deal forward. Challenges are part of the role, and you thrive in solving them under pressure.



Requirements

- Minimum 2+ years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations

- Proven track record of closing real estate deals and securing signed contracts

- Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)

- Confidence and professionalism on the phone; ability to build trust and rapport quickly

- Familiarity with real estate terms like ARV, repairs, inspection, contingencies, etc.

- Strong work ethic, coachability, and ability to follow scripts while sounding natural

- Proficiency with CRMs and outbound dialers

- Reliable high-speed internet, updated computer, and a quiet workspace



What We’re Looking For

- A confident, friendly, and persuasive communicator who thrives on results

- Someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and relentless in follow-up

- A professional with the drive to close contracts and grow with a fast-moving team



Why Join Us?

- Competitive pay with structured bonuses

- Real opportunities for growth in a professional investment company

- Work remotely with a team that supports your success

- A chance to close real deals, make a real impact, and develop long-term career skills in acquisitions



At Price Real Estate Investments, acquisitions is the heartbeat of our business. You’ll be in the front seat, driving growth and learning the strategies that power real deals across multiple U.S. markets.



How to Apply: (Read Carefully – Incomplete Applications Will Be Ignored)

-
 us at:

Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered.

- Monitor rent collections, track arrears, and escalate delinquencies



Documentation & Communication

What types of properties will I manage?

How is this different from the Assistant Property Manager role?

The Senior APM leads and supervises the APM team, handles escalated tenant situations and legal processes, and is involved in financial decisions including budgeting, vendor negotiations, and lease pricing. You are expected to operate independently and make sound decisions.

mbers need it, and take over tasks yourself when the situation requires it. If you're the type of leader who only gives orders from a distance, this role isn't for you.

).

mbers to help you get up to speed on our specific processes. While we expect you to bring US property management knowledge, we'll train you on our systems and workflows.

mber, verified the work, and stepped in when guidance was needed

8. Your availability to start

Aoede LLC is a Texas-based property management company overseeing a growing, diversified portfolio of commercial, single-family, and short-term rental properties across Texas and California. Our team of 10+ professionals spans multiple countries and operates fully remote, managing everything from a 70-unit commercial building in Houston to Airbnb properties in Austin and single-family rentals in California. We hire talent from around the world — including the Philippines, Vietnam, India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Venezuela, and beyond. We don't care where you sit. We care how you perform.



What makes us different: we combine the speed and scrappiness of a startup with the processes, structure, and professionalism you'd expect from a much larger organization. We invest heavily in documentation — our runbooks and tutorials are built so that the right person can get up to speed quickly and operate independently. We reward performance, not tenure. If you learn the material, execute at a high level, and take ownership of your work, you'll grow here.



Our culture is built on communication, collaboration, and humility. We operate as a team — not in silos. We value honesty over impressive claims. Please don't tell us you're an expert in something you've only read about or briefly touched. This is a company where your work matters, your voice is heard, and your growth is directly tied to what you put in.

title: Solar PV Design & Technical Specialist (Remote)
description:
Role:

Solar PV Design & Technical Specialist (Remote)

We’re Solar Guys Pro, a fast-growing e-commerce startup simplifying the chaos of buying solar equipment.

Whether you're building an off-grid cabin, a home backup system, or a full-scale solar array, we help customers get the right products, expert guidance, and fast delivery — without the usual complexity and delays that plague this industry.

We don’t just list SKUs. We solve real operational problems, for both customers and suppliers by simplifying the supply chain of solar.

In a space of outdated technology and inefficient systems, our vision is to become the most operationally efficient backend in the solar e-commerce space, built with smart systems, lean processes, and a laser focus on execution.

We’re lean. We’re profitable. We move fast.

No investors. No fluff. Just clean systems, clean energy, and clean execution.

We're a small remote team with a bias toward action, ownership, and results.

Every person here is a builder — not a bystander.



Your mission is simple:



- Build and maintain the technical foundation of our solar systems — every single day.

- You will own the full technical function of a fast-growing 7-figure solar e-commerce company.

-  From system sizing to full configurations, BOM creation to system standardization, you’ll ensure our technical engine is accurate, scalable, and efficient.

- This is not a passive technical role.

-  You won’t just “design systems.”

- You will interpret requirements, question configurations, improve system logic, and build scalable solutions.

- We’re looking for a detail-obsessed, fast-moving Solar PV Specialist with strong experience (2–5+ years), preferably in off-grid and hybrid systems.

- You should be meticulous and structured — but also proactive, system-oriented, and two steps ahead. Someone who sees technical gaps before they arise and builds systems to prevent them.

- You'll be the person ensuring our systems are complete, our configurations are accurate, our kits are install-ready, and our technical foundation is rock solid across all products, setups, and use cases.



Work Schedule

- This is a full-time remote role (8 hours/day). You must be fully available during 9 AM – 5 PM EST, M-F.





Key Responsibilities



1. Solar System Design

Own the full lifecycle of solar system design, including system sizing, architecture, and configuration

Design off-grid, hybrid, and grid-tied systems based on real-world use cases

Create complete system layouts (roof and ground mount)

2. System Configuration & Technical Accuracy

Build complete, install-ready Bills of Materials (BOMs) for all systems

Ensure all required components are included (wiring, breakers, mounts, etc.)

Validate compatibility across all system components

Identify and eliminate missing components, errors, and configuration risks

3. Technical System Logic & Standardization

Define how products work together across all system types

s, and CRM entries without dropping the ball

title: NJ Public Works Estimator ONLY — DIV 9 — Must Know NJ Prevailing Wage/Davis-Bacon
description:
Division 9 Estimator — NJ Public Works Projects ONLY (Prevailing Wage / Davis-Bacon)

$10 TO $12/hr | Full-Time | 9 AM – 5 PM EST | Remote | Long-Term



FILTER PHRASE — REQUIRED AT THE TOP OF YOUR APPLICATION

Begin your application with:

"I know how to build and what it costs."

If this phrase is missing, your application will not be read.



About Us

JLC Construction and Schear LLC are sister companies. We self-perform Division 9 and interior finishes with 200+ men in the field and 200+ years of combined back-office construction experience.

This position is for estimating Division 9 interior finishes on New Jersey public works projects only. We are not hiring for private work, other trades, or other states. If you do not have direct NJ public works estimating experience, do not apply.

We do not want a takeoff specialist. We do not want a quantity surveyor. We want a true estimator — someone who reads a set of drawings and immediately sees what is missing, what is risky, what is underpriced, and what it actually costs to build.



THE ROLE — READ CAREFULLY

This is a Division 9 estimating role for NJ public works projects ONLY. You must have direct, hands-on experience bidding New Jersey public works, you must understand Davis-Bacon and NJ prevailing wage / local NJ labor rates, you must know how to estimate those rates per job, and you must be able to write up the scopes and contracts to match. If you do not possess these qualifications, do not apply.



What You Will Own — Start to Finish (Division 9, NJ Public Works)



Quantity takeoffs — accurate, thorough, drawing-overlay verified across every addendum

Scope writing — clear, complete, defensible scopes that protect the company

Pricing — labor, material, equipment, overhead, profit built from first principles

NJ prevailing wage / Davis-Bacon pricing — local NJ labor rates estimated correctly per job

Bid-stage scheduling — durations, sequencing, manpower assumptions tied to the estimate

RFIs during the bid — flag missing or ambiguous information before submission, in writing

RFPs to subs — for any trade we do not self-perform

Bid leveling — apples-to-apples sub comparison, scope gap identification

Buyout — lock in subs after award, finalize scopes, issue contracts

Risk identification — every assumption, clarification, exclusion, and risk written into the bid

Drawing overlays — adds and deducts between original drawings and every addendum





Requirements — Non-Negotiable



5+ years full-time as a true construction estimator. Not a takeoff specialist. Not a quantity surveyor.

Direct NJ public works estimating experience — hands-on bidding of New Jersey public works projects

Division 9 / interior fit-out specialty — drywall, metal framing, ACT, flooring, paint, wall coverings, millwork, Level 5 drywall, premium finishes

Davis-Bacon and NJ prevailing wage pricing — understand local NJ labor rates, how to estimate them per job, how prevailing-wage rates change an estimate, and how to write scopes and contracts to match

NJ labor productivity and market rates — sub coordination on public work

Drawing-overlay proficiency in PlanSwift, On-Screen Takeoff, or Bluebeam — daily hands-on, not occasional

Advanced Excel — formulas, linked sheets, multi-tab workbooks

Strong written and spoken English — RFIs, scopes, GC and architect
s, video calls

U.S. imperial measurements — feet, inches, SF, LF, CY — fluent

Available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup power and connection



Spreadsheet-only estimating is disqualifying. Takeoffs alone are disqualifying.



REQUIRED — Send These Work Samples

Applications without work samples will not be reviewed. Send at least three of the following, from real bids you personally built:



Completed estimate sheets (takeoff + pricing buildup + total)

Scopes of work you wrote (inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, clarifications)

RFI logs you sent during a live bid

Sub bid leveling sheets (apples-to-apples comparison)

Buyout summaries (post-award sub contract package)



Confidential project names can be redacted. Line items, unit rates, productivity, and totals must remain visible. Resumes with no samples will not move forward.



Tell Me About a Real Bid

In your application, describe one specific NJ public works bid where you identified a major risk, scope gap, or missing information that the GC, architect, or owner had overlooked. What was the project, what did you catch, what did you do about it, what was the outcome?

A takeoff specialist cannot answer this. A real estimator has stories ready.



Nice to Have



NJ school, university, or municipal public works experience

Procore, Bluebeam, or Revit working knowledge

Certified payroll / NJ prevailing wage compliance familiarity





Compensation



$8.50–$10/hr depending on experience and demonstrated work samples

40 hours per week, paid weekly

Long-term position with growth potential

Performance bonus tied to bid accuracy and hit rate





How to Apply

Send the following directly to 
 — applications submitted only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed:



Your resume

Work samples (see required list above)

A written description covering:





Your direct NJ public works estimating experience

The Division 9 scopes you have personally priced

Your experience with Davis-Bacon and NJ prevailing wage / local NJ labor rate pricing — how you estimate them per job and write the scopes and contracts

The risk identification story (see section above)





The filter phrase at the top: "I know how to build and what it costs."



Direct applicants only. No recruiters.

Estimate Planswift Quantity Takeoff

title: Bookkeeper / Monthly Financial Review
description:
Purpose of the role JobTracks operates a Manual & AI-assisted bookkeeping pipeline: source documents (PDF invoices, Excel payroll and AP reports, credit-card feeds) are extracted and classified into QuickBooks Online via manual entry and a structured import tool. This role should not need to perform manual data entry. Its purpose is to review, reconcile, correct, and close the books each month — to be the human control layer that catches what the data entry gets wrong and to own the accuracy of the financial record.



Core responsibilities Review transaction entries for correct account classification, flagging and correcting misclassifications before close. Reconcile all bank and credit-card accounts monthly against statements. Verify that automated invoice, bill, and expense imports match source documents on a sampled and exception basis. Confirm payroll entries tie out to ADP records (ADP retains responsibility for payroll tax filing). Manage the exception queue — any transaction the automation flags as low-confidence or cannot classify. Perform monthly close and produce P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements. Identify control gaps or recurring error patterns in the automated pipeline and report them so the upstream rules can be improved.

What this role does NOT do Manual keying of invoices or expenses. Payroll tax filing (ADP). Tax preparation or strategic tax/decree advice (handled by outside CPA/tax counsel).



Required qualifications Hands-on QuickBooks Online proficiency, including reconciliation and month-end close. Demonstrated bookkeeping experience for a company with 1,000+ monthly transactions. Comfort reviewing and correcting machine-generated entries rather than originating them i.e., an editor's mindset, not a data-entry mindset. Strong attention to classification accuracy and an instinct for what "looks wrong."



Preferred Experience with multi-entity bookkeeping (JobTracks operates more than one company). Familiarity with QuickBooks import tools (SaasAnt, Transaction Pro, or similar).



Engagement terms Monthly retainer, scope sized to transaction volume. Specific monthly deliverable: reconciled accounts and closed books with financial statements delivered by [X] business days after month-end.

title: Senior US Tax Preparer (UltraTax) - Full-Time
description:
ABOUT WHYTE CPA P.C.



We're a virtual CPA firm in Gilbert, Arizona serving about 60 monthly clients. Our niche is S-corporation owners and real estate investors. Small firm, lean operation, high standards on the work that goes out the door.



The owner does all final review and signs every return. He's not trying to hand that off right now — he's trying to stop spending it on cleanup. Right now too much review time goes to fixing prep that should have come in clean. This role exists to fix that. We need a senior preparer whose work product is clean, complete, and well-reasoned enough that the owner's review is fast confirmation, not rework.



If you're the kind of preparer who hands up tidy workpapers, flags your own open questions before anyone asks, and never guesses when you could check — read on.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



This is a year-round, full-time, prep-first role.



COMPLEX RETURN PREPARATION. Federal and state returns: heavy on 1040s with K-1s, 1120Ss, partnerships, and 1041s. Most returns include K-1s (most prepared by us), Schedule E with rentals, brokerage statements, and frequently a Schedule C or Schedule E pg 1. These are not generic 1040s. You prepare the returns that require senior-level judgment — S-corp basis, Section 199A, depreciation, multistate — from source documents through clean, review-ready work product.



QUARTERLY TAX PLANNING PREP. Using UltraTax's tax planner and annualized financials, you build the projection, identify planning opportunities, and flag unreasonable assumptions for the owner's review.



IRS AND STATE NOTICE WORK (LATER). Low volume, a few a month. You won't own this on day one — but as you settle in, routine notices (math errors, balance due, missing forms) become work you draft and handle, with the owner reviewing and signing.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE: bookkeeping (a teammate owns that), and final review/sign-off (the owner does that for now).



A NOTE ON GROWTH. This is a prep-first role and we're hiring you to be excellent at prep. If you're ambitious and want to grow toward review work over time, there's genuinely room for that here. If you'd rather be the strongest preparer on the team and settle in for the long haul, that's just as welcome. No pressure either direction — tell us honestly where you sit.





WHO YOU ARE



You have 5+ years of US tax experience, with the bulk of it in hands-on preparation of complex returns — not bookkeeping, not entry-level data entry. Be ready to talk concretely about the returns you've prepared.



You know S-corp work concretely: basis tracking, Section 199A computation, reasonable comp analysis, distributions vs. wages. Partnership and 1041 experience is a strong plus.



You have hands-on experience with UltraTax CS, CCH Axcess, Lacerte, or ProConnect.



You write in clear, professional English (C1 or higher). Your workpapers and planning memos need to be readable by a reviewer in one pass, and any client-facing notes need to land cleanly.



You are detail-oriented and self-policing. When you don't know something, you say so and look it up rather than guessing. You flag your own uncertainty before someone has to ask. Your workpapers are organized enough that someone else can follow your reasoning without a phone call.



You are comfortable with AI-augmented workflows. Our process uses Claude and TaxGPT alongside human judgment. Strong candidates are either already using AI tools in their work or genuinely curious to learn — we'll train you on ours. Candidates who view AI as a gimmick are not a fit.



You are self-directed in a remote-first environment. The owner travels for portions of the year and time zone overlap will shift accordingly. We need someone who runs their own queue with minimal oversight.



Real estate experience (rentals, short-term rentals, cost segregation, 1031 exchanges) is helpful but not required. We can teach the niche; we can't teach prep judgment.





SOFTWARE STACK



Required: UltraTax CS (preferred) or CCH Axcess, TaxDome, QuickBooks Online familiarity

Acceptable in place of UltraTax: Lacerte or ProConnect with willingness to learn UltraTax

Not acceptable: Drake-only experience

Used in workflow: Claude, TaxGPT, IRS Solutions, Excel, Adobe Acrobat Pro



If your tax software experience is Drake only, please don't apply. We're not the right fit.





COMPENSATION



Base salary: $3,000/month USD (paid twice monthly via Wise, on time, every time)

13th month: $3,000 paid in December, prorated for partial first year

Internet stipend: $50/month

Health allowance: $75/month

Total annual comp: ~$40,500 USD



Base may increase to $3,400/month for an exceptional candidate after the test process.



Hours: Full-time, salary (not hourly, no overtime). This role follows the tax calendar, and the rhythm matters more than the raw hours.



Filing season — roughly January 20 through April 15 — is the heavy stretch. Expect 50–55 hours with full Arizona overlap, and that time is focused return work. We pull back on admin, training, and process projects during the crunch so the prep gets done.



Outside season, a standard week is around 40 hours, but it's a different mix — return work alongside admin, process improvement, and your own professional development, at a more sustainable pace.



Summer is genuinely lighter. When the workload allows, we run reduced hours — often half-day Fridays, and during the slow stretch those shorter days don't require Arizona overlap at all. That's the firm's call based on what's in the queue, not a fixed schedule you can count on week to week. Light weeks don't cost you pay — you're salaried.



Two short periods — late summer and early October, for extensions — return to a focused 40 with normal Arizona overlap. We give advance notice so you can plan around them.



Time off:

- All standard PH public holidays observed and paid.

- A bank of 15 paid days/year (vacation + sick), yours to manage.

- One long weekend (Friday–Sunday) off during tax season, scheduled with two weeks' notice.

- Outside tax season, you manage your own time — take what you need from your bank, communicate, keep your work current. We don't micromanage the calendar.





HIRING PROCESS



1. Application — Submit per the instructions below. Generic applications are discarded immediately.

2. First screen — 30-minute video call with the owner.

3. Paid prep test — One real client (sanitized data), $400 USD, ~2–3 hours, due within 7 days. You build the judgment-heavy workpapers in Excel and write a short prep memo — no tax software required. We're testing your prep judgment, not your software speed.

4. Judgment interview — a 45–60 minute call discussing your test, plus 2–3 scenario questions.

5. Reference check — One reference from a recent supervisor or peer.

6. Offer



Total process: 2–3 weeks for serious candidates.





HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with the subject line: "Senior Preparer — [Your Full Name]"



Include the following. If your application doesn't follow this structure, we'll assume you didn't read the post. (Strong, clearly-qualified resumes may still get a follow-up — but answering these up front moves you faster.)



1. Experience summary (3–5 sentences): Your years in US tax, how much is hands-on complex preparation, the type of firm you've worked at, and the volume/type of returns you've prepared.



2. Tax software: Which of UltraTax CS, CCH Axcess, Lacerte, ProConnect have you used? For each, name the specific modules (1040, 1120S, 1065, 1041) and roughly how many returns you've prepared in each.



3. DISC scores (if available). If you haven't taken DISC, OnlineJobs.ph has a free 10-minute test — please take it before applying.



4. A complex return you prepared (a short paragraph): Name a specific judgment call — an S-corp basis or Section 199A position, a tricky depreciation or multistate issue — how you worked it, and how you made your work product clean enough to hand to a reviewer. We want one concrete example with real detail, not your whole résumé.



5. AI in your workflow (2–3 sentences): How do you currently use Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools in your tax work? If you don't currently use them, how would you approach learning a firm's AI-augmented process?



6. Availability: Earliest start date and any current employment that would need to transition. Confirm you can overlap 4–5 hours with Arizona business hours.



We're hiring for fit, not speed. Process moves quickly for serious applicants — but we'll wait for the right person.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- Not bookkeeping — a teammate owns that

- Not the final reviewer (the owner reviews and signs for now)

- Not for someone learning US tax — you should already know it

- Not part-time or seasonal

- Not a stepping stone — we want someone who wants to settle in

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Solve the Hard Stuff. Keep Customers Moving. 



JOB SUMMARY 



Cybernautic's customers need fast, reliable technical support from someone who actually knows what they're doing. That's where you come in.  



As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll handle the majority of website-related support tickets — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, CMS updates, bug fixes, DNS records, and
 hosting — so our development team stays focused on building great things. You'll be the first line of defense, and you'll resolve most issues without needing to escalate. 



This is a technically sharp, code-capable support role for someone who loves solving problems, communicates clearly, and takes ownership from first contact to resolution. You'll work across our in-house CMS (Editor), Shopify, Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Rackspace and OpenSRS
, FreshDesk, and more — and you'll use AI tools to troubleshoot faster, write better, and work smarter. 



This role is based in the Philippines and requires availability during U.S. business hours. You'll work closely with our U.S.-based Client Services Specialist, communicate directly with clients by
 and occasionally by phone or video, and hold yourself to a high standard — because our customers do. 



If you have real website development experience, strong English communication skills, and the instincts to investigate problems thoroughly before asking for help — this role was built for you. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO 



Website & CMS Support 

* Troubleshoot, resolve, and directly implement fixes for website support tickets across front-end and back-end issues 

* Create, modify, and troubleshoot CMS content structures to support client requests 

* Provide CMS training and guidance to website administrators as needed 

* Use appropriate technical tools and resources to investigate issues and identify root causes 

* Test all changes before closing a ticket — browser compatibility, mobile responsiveness, form functionality, and unintended side effects 

* Document findings, steps taken, files changed, and resolutions clearly within every ticket 

* Protect website stability by following established development, testing, backup, and change-management practices before making updates to live client websites 

* Investigate and resolve the majority of website issues independently, escalating to the development team only when necessary and always with clear documentation 

*  Keep the Client Services Specialist informed of ticket status, technical findings, and escalation needs 



DNS &
 Hosting Support 

* Assist clients with DNS record configuration in GoDaddy and Cloudflare 

* Troubleshoot and resolve SSL certificate issues, including expired certificates, mixed content warnings, and domain verification problems 

* Support clients using Rackspace
 and assist with migrating accounts to OpenSRS, including DNS setup, mailbox migration, and client coordination 

* Help clients configure Rackspace and OpenSRS
 accounts into leading
 applications including Outlook, Gmail, and mobile mail clients 

* Identify and escalate systemic
 delivery or routing issues to vendors as needed 



Shopify Support 

* Troubleshoot and resolve Shopify storefront issues including theme layout problems, navigation, page content, section and block configuration, and checkout display issues 

* Assist clients with connecting custom domains to Shopify, including DNS configuration, SSL verification, and subdomain and redirect setup 

* Help clients with basic Shopify admin tasks including product setup, collections, metafields, and page content management 

* Escalate complex Shopify development requests — such as custom development, advanced Liquid logic, or API integrations — to a lead developer with full documentation 



Customer & Ticket Management 

* Interact with clients to provide timely support and information across all assigned channels 

* Manage the full ticket lifecycle: opening, assigning, monitoring, escalating, and resolving support tickets 

* Troubleshoot and resolve general account and access issues, including password resets, account lockouts, and client inquiries not handled by a dedicated support section 

* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, including details of inquiries, complaints, and actions taken 

* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate team member or vendor partner with thorough documentation 

* Fulfill all service level standards for response time and quality 



Knowledge Management 

* Develop and maintain a library of support articles, how-to guides, and best practices  

* Flag outdated or inaccurate articles and update them to reflect current products and procedures 

* Document troubleshooting patterns and contribute new content that reduces repeat ticket volume 



AI-Assisted Workflows 

* Incorporate AI tools into daily support workflows to improve response quality, efficiency, and consistency 

* Use AI to assist with code troubleshooting, research, documentation, and client communications — always verifying AI-generated output before applying it to live systems 

* Stay current on emerging AI tools and recommend new applications that benefit the support team 



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 



You'll need: 

* Practical experience troubleshooting and updating websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, including CMS-driven sites — content updates, layout fixes, template edits, and moderately complex code changes 

* Strong understanding of website hosting, domains, and DNS, including the ability to create, update, troubleshoot, and migrate records such as A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC 

* Experience troubleshooting
 setup and delivery issues, including mailbox configuration, configuring
 into client applications, DNS-related
 problems, and basic deliverability issues 

* Familiarity with FTP/SFTP, hosting control panels, CMS admin tools, browser developer tools, and basic server resources for investigating and resolving issues 

* Comfortable using AI tools to assist with technical troubleshooting, code review, research, documentation, and rewriting client replies — with good judgment about verifying recommendations before applying them 

* Ability to investigate technical problems independently, review code and configurations thoroughly, document findings clearly, and balance speed with accuracy on live systems 

* Strong English communication skills — written and verbal — including clear, professional client-facing responses and the ability to join client calls when needed

Working Hours

- Availability during European business hours is a plus



What We Offer

- Starting rate: $3/hour (full-time, 40 hours per week).

- Long-term collaboration within a growing and ambitious team.

1. Why are you motivated to work in customer service for an e-commerce company?

Best,

Emily”

title: Real Estate Accountant — Not Basic Bookkeeping
description:
JOB POST: Real Estate Accountant (Not Basic Bookkeeping)



Do NOT apply unless you understand real estate GAAP accounting.



We are a U.S. real estate investment company. This is not a data-entry bookkeeping role. If you do not understand the difference between operating expenses, capital expenses, financing costs, and sponsor fees, do not apply. If you do not know how to book purchase and sales of property, do not apply. 



This role requires real accounting judgment. You must correctly handle:



Acquisition fees paid to sponsor (not operating expense)

Loan origination and debt signing fees (capitalized and amortized)

Leasing commissions (capitalized over lease term)

Sponsor guaranty fees (GP compensation, not NOI)

Sale transaction costs (reduce proceeds, not operating expense)

Legal fees: eviction vs acquisition vs financing (different treatment)

NOI reporting vs below-the-line items





Mandatory application test (required):



To apply, answer clearly:



How do you record an acquisition fee paid to the sponsor?



How do you treat a loan origination fee on a 5-year loan?



How do you treat a leasing commission on a 10-year lease?



How do you classify a guaranty fee paid to the GP?



Difference between legal fees for tenant eviction vs property purchase?



Is interest an operating expense or financing expense?



We will reject applicants who:



Do not understand NOI

Cannot explain journal entries

Have never worked with real estate entities

Send copy/paste generic responses



Position details:



Remote

Full-time

Must overlap with U.S. Eastern Time!!!

Pay depends on proven skill



Final note:



This role is closer to a junior real estate accountant/controller, not a clerk. If you are highly qualified, we will pay well. If not, do not apply.

title: Day Trading
description:
Position: Forex Trader / Account Manager

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Type: Part-Time / Performance-Based

Base Retainer: $300 per month

Profit Share: 10% to Trader / 90% to Account Owner

Starting Capital: $500 (scalable upon proven performance)

Drawdown Limit:Max 2–3?ily | Max 5–8% overall

Reporting: Weekly performance updates required



POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a disciplined, data-driven, and consistently profitable Forex Account Manager to actively trade and manage a dedicated capital account. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of navigating the FX markets with strict risk management, emotional control, and a clearly defined trading edge.



This is a performance-based role. You trade the capital — we share the profits. Capital under management will be scaled significantly for traders who demonstrate consistent and responsible growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Active Trading & Market Analysis:

Analyse major and minor FX pairs and execute trades based on a verified, structured trading strategy.

Maintain consistent market engagement aligned with agreed trading windows and session coverage.



Risk Management

Strictly adhere to a maximum daily drawdown of 2–3% and an overall account drawdown limit of 5–8%.

Preserve capital as the primary operational mandate — profit generation is secondary to drawdown control.

Avoid over-leveraging, martingale, grid strategies, and revenge trading in all circumstances.



Consistency & Performance

Deliver steady, scalable account growth with minimal volatility.

Execute only within pre-agreed risk parameters, regardless of market conditions.



Reporting & Communication

Submit weekly performance updates including trade summary, equity curve, and forward outlook.

Maintain open, professional communication regarding strategy adjustments and significant market events.

Provide access to live account monitoring dashboard at all times.



POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Track Record

Minimum 6–12 months of verified, consistent profitability.

Verification must be provided via authenticated broker statements.

Applications without a verifiable trading history will not be considered.



Strategy & Methodology

Must be able to clearly articulate the trading methodology used (e.g. price action, smart money concepts, swing trading, algorithmic assistance).

Strategy must have a demonstrable positive expectancy over the verified period.

Pure martingale, grid, or recovery-based strategies are strictly excluded.



Risk Discipline

Absolute commitment to the agreed daily and overall drawdown thresholds.

Demonstrated ability to remain within predefined risk parameters during adverse market conditions.



Psychological Maturity

Ability to handle losing streaks with composure and return to strategy without deviation.

No history of account blow-ups, uncontrolled drawdowns, or significant unexplained losses.



COMPENSATION & TERMS

Component                             

Base Retainer:    

$300 per month, paid regardless of performance

Profit Share:  

10% to Trader|90% to Account Owner paid monthly            

Capital Scaling:   

Starting at $500; scaled significantly upon consistent performance

Working Arrangement:

100% remote. Flexible hours provided risk parameters are respected.





HOW TO APPLY

If you have the discipline and the data to support your trading credentials, please apply by submitting the following:



A brief introduction outlining your trading style, experience, and preferred markets.

A verified track record link or screenshot (MyFxBook preferred; FXBlue or broker statements accepted).

Your profit-share expectations and preferred risk parameters.



Important Notice



Applications without a verifiable track record or references to past performance will not be considered. We value quality over volume and are looking for a long-term professional trading relationship built on trust, discipline, and measurable results.

title: Sales Representative
description:

This role starts ASAP!!

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea
mbers can learn from them

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. description:
The Birdhouse Records

Content Creator (Short-Form / Music / House)

Remote · Part-time (?10 hrs/week)



About Birdhouse:

Birdhouse Records is an independent house music label focused on disco, funky, and groove-driven music.

We’re building artists, not just releasing tracks.

That means content isn’t filler, it’s how the music spreads.



The Role:



This is not a posting role.

This is not just video editing.



You are responsible for:

Finding what works

Turning that into ideas

Executing those ideas into content

You will not be filming yourself.



You will be working with:

DJ footage

Artist-submitted clips

Existing online media

Raw assets we provide



Your job is to turn that into content people actually watch.



Responsibilities:



1. Research (this is a big part of the job)

Study artists, labels, and music accounts that are growing

Identify specific posts that are performing well

Break down why they work (hook, format, pacing)

Bring back ideas we can replicate or adapt



2. Concept Development

Turn tracks, moments, or artist stories into content ideas

Create clear concepts before editing (not just “cut clips together”)

Suggest what footage we need from artists when necessary



3. Editing & Execution

Create short-form videos (10–90 seconds)

Use hooks, captions, pacing, and structure that drive retention

Edit using tools like CapCut, Premiere, etc. (nothing overly complex)



4. Content Output

Focus on Instagram first (Reels), with reuse for TikTok/Shorts

Aim for consistent, repeatable formats and not random one-offs

Prioritize engagement and watch time over “polished” visuals



5. Optimization

Pay attention to what performs

Double down on winning formats

Iterate quickly



What We’re Looking For:

You understand house / EDM culture (required)

You’ve created or managed content that gets consistent engagement

Doesn’t need to be viral

But should show ~1k+ views per post consistently

You know what makes someone stop scrolling

You can think in formats and hooks, not just edits

You are proactive and don’t need constant direction

You speak fluent english (accent is okay)



What We Don’t Need:

Someone who only edits clips we hand them

Someone who waits to be told exactly what to do

Someone focused on “cinematic” or overly polished content



If that’s you, this won’t be a fit.



Bonus (Not Required):

Experience working with artists or music brands

Basic understanding of music promotion

DJ/producer background



What Success Looks Like:

Consistent content output every week 

Repeatable content formats that perform

Regular posts hitting 1k–5k+ views, with some scaling higher

Clear improvement over time based on iteration



What You Get:

Direct access to artists and releases

Creative ownership (we expect ideas, not just execution)

Flexible, remote work

Opportunity to grow with the label



How to Apply:



Send:

2–5 examples of content you’ve created

Links to any accounts you’ve managed (if applicable)

A short note on why you’re a fit

Optional (recommended):

2–3 content ideas for a house music release

title: TikTok/Reels Content Research VA + Basic CapCut Editor for AI Image/Video App
description:
# Job Title: TikTok/Reels Content Research VA + Basic CapCut Editor for AI Image/Video App



## About the Project



We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app.



Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI photos, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content.



We are looking for a creative and organized Virtual Assistant who understands TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, AI content, viral trends, and basic short-form editing.



This role will start with a **3-day paid trial**. If the work is strong, this can become a long-term part-time or full-time role.



---



## Main Goal of the Role



Your main job is to help us find viral AI photo/video trends and turn them into content ideas, app template ideas, hooks, captions, and simple short-form videos.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a content system for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is not only an admin role. We need someone creative, curious, and interested in AI apps and viral content.



---



## Responsibilities



### 1. TikTok / Reels / Shorts Trend Research



You will research viral content formats related to:



* AI video

* AI image generation

* Photo-to-video

* Image-to-video

* AI dance videos

* AI photo edits

* AI portraits

* AI animation

* Viral filters and effects

* 
-style AI videos

* Creator tools

* Short-form video apps



You will collect useful links and organize them clearly in Google Sheets or Notion.



---



### 2. Content Idea Generation



You will create content ideas for Kreo AI based on viral trends.



Example content ideas:



* “Turn your selfie into this”

* “AI made my photo dance”

* “Photo-to-video AI is getting crazy”

* “3 AI effects you need to try”

* “Normal photo vs AI video result”

* “Which effect should we launch next?”

* “This AI turned my selfie into a movie scene”

* “Would you try this with your photo?”



You should be able to study viral videos and turn them into practical ideas for our app.



---



### 3. AI App Template Ideas



You will suggest new AI image and video template ideas for Kreo AI.



Example template ideas:



* AI Dance

* Photo to Video

* Cinematic Zoom

* Stadium Fan Cam

* AI Headshot

* Anime Portrait

* Fashion Walk

* Couple Effect

* Pet Dance

* Glow-Up Reveal

* AI Movie Poster

* Product Ad Image

* Talking Photo

* Viral 
 Effect

* Fantasy Portrait



---



### 4. Hooks and Captions



You will write short hooks and captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.



Example hooks:



* “This AI turned my selfie into a movie scene.”

* “Would you try this with your photo?”

* “AI video apps are getting scary good.”

* “This photo-to-video effect looks unreal.”

* “Which version is better: 1 or 2?”

* “This is what AI can do with one photo.”



Good English is required.



---



### 5. Basic Short-Form Video Editing



You should be able to create simple short-form videos using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools.



Basic editing includes:



* Vertical 9:16 video editing

* Adding text overlays

* Cutting clips

* Adding captions

* Using simple transitions

* Creating before/after videos

* Creating simple thumbnail/cover images

* Exporting TikTok/Reels-ready videos

* Organizing finished content for posting



Advanced editing is not required, but basic CapCut or Canva skill is preferred.



---



### 6. Competitor Research



You will track competitor apps and content.



Examples:



* AI video generator apps

* AI photo editor apps

* Photo-to-video apps

* AI dance apps

* Apps creating viral TikTok/Reels content



You will observe:



* What content they post

* Which videos perform well

* What hooks they use

* What templates/effects they promote

* What ideas Kreo AI should test



---



## Trial Task



Before long-term hiring, selected candidates will complete a **3-day paid trial task**.



The trial task will include:



1. Find 10 viral AI video examples from TikTok/Reels/Shorts

2. Find 10 viral AI photo/image examples

3. Suggest 10 content ideas for Kreo AI

4. Suggest 10 app template ideas

5. Write 10 short hooks/captions

6. Create 1 simple 10–15 second TikTok/Reel sample using CapCut or Canva

7. Submit everything in an organized Google Sheet or document



Please only apply if you are comfortable doing this type of work.



---



## Long-Term Role



If the paid trial is successful, this can become a long-term role.



We may start with:



* 4 hours/day, 5 days/week



Then increase to:



* full-time, 40 hours/week



This depends on performance, quality of work, communication, and reliability.



---



## Daily Tasks After Hiring



If hired long term, your daily tasks may include:



1. Find viral TikTok/Reels/Shorts references

2. Suggest AI video content ideas

3. Suggest AI image/photo content ideas

4. Write hooks and captions

5. Track competitor content

6. Suggest Kreo AI template ideas

## Required Skills

* Experience managing social media pages

* Experience with YouTube Shorts

* Experience writing TikTok hooks

* Experience with UGC content research

* Experience finding influencers or creators

* Experience with app marketing

* Experience with competitor research



---



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Creative

* Fast

* Organized

* Honest

* Detail-oriented

* Interested in AI content

* Familiar with TikTok/Reels trends

* Able to think independently

title: Junior Bookkeeper – Ironbooks
description:

## The Vision



We're building the AI-powered bookkeeping service for trades contractors. And we're doing it differently.



Most bookkeeping firms are dinosaurs—slow, expensive, offshore labor treated as a cost center. We're proving the opposite: that the best bookkeepers aren't in expensive US metros. They're smart, hungry, high-D/high-C operators who want to build something real.



**You're not joining a bookkeeping team. You're joining the proof of concept that AI + offshore talent + ruthless execution = the future of accounting operations.**



Every client we onboard. Every book you clean up. Every report you own. That's market validation that traditional accounting firms are about to get disrupted.



---



## What You're Actually Building



This role is ground zero for something bigger:



- **You're the backbone of Ironbooks' operations.** Every client win flows through the work you do. You're not hidden in the back office—your work directly drives revenue, client retention, and company reputation.



- **You're proving a thesis.** We're showing that a Filipino bookkeeper + Claude AI + clear processes = better, faster, cheaper than traditional US-based accounting. That's not a side hustle. That's category-defining.



- **You're scaling a system, not just doing work.** Right now, you're learning. In 6 months, you're training others. In 12 months, you're leading a team and working with our CEO on process improvement. This grows with you.



- **You're part of the Painter Growth ecosystem.** Ironbooks isn't standalone—it's the operational proof point for Painter Growth's AI positioning across the trades. Your work is literally the case study we use to sell coaching and other services. High visibility. Real leverage.



---



## Why This Matters (For You)



**If you're the type who wants more than a job:**



- You'll see direct ROI on your effort. Ship a clean book ? client signs for annual contract ? you see the impact immediately.

- You're not a cost center. You're a revenue driver. That matters differently when you know it.

- You're learning a category-defining skill set: bookkeeping + AI automation + operational systems. That's not replaceable. That's your edge.

- There's a real path here. We're scaling. The people who prove themselves in the first 6 months aren't stuck in junior roles—they move into leadership, specialist tracks, or new ventures as we expand.

- You're working with founders who care about outcomes and speed, not politics. That changes everything about how work feels.



---



## The Reality



We're lean. We move fast. We don't tolerate slow thinking or excuses. But we also:



- Celebrate wins loudly (and mean it)

- Pay attention to people who deliver

- Build in public (you'll see how your work impacts the market)

- Give autonomy to people who earn it

- Actually promote from within



---



## What We Need



**Must-haves:**

- 2+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

- Fluent English (writing and speaking)

- Comfortable with QuickBooks Online

- High D energy: you want to win, you move fast, you own your output

- High C discipline: you catch errors, you care about quality, you want to build systems that work

- Previous remote work or offshore experience

- Familiarity with Zapier or integration platforms

- Trades or contractor business background



---



## The First 90 Days



- **Month 1:** You're learning our systems, processes, and standards. You're doing deep work on client cleanups and learning to work alongside our AI tools.

- **Month 2:** You're owning client relationships independently. You're proofing your own work, shipping reports, and starting to see patterns in what works.

- **Month 3:** You're refining our processes. You're identifying bottlenecks. You're having ideas about how we do things better. We're listening.



By the end of 90 days, we know if you're the one who grows with us.



---



## Compensation & Benefits



- **Salary:** $7/hr with opportunities for bonuses and raises quickly if demonstrating high quality and great work ethic

- **Hours:** 8 hours/day, PST-aligned (flexible within reason)

- **Tools:** All software, licenses, and AI tools provided

If that's you, let's talk.
