description:
# Virtual Front Desk — Refine Med Spa

**Remote (Philippines-based) · Full-time · US Mountain Time hours**



## About Refine Med Spa

Refine Med Spa is building Denver's premier network of medical aesthetics practices — injectables, laser, and advanced skincare — under one operating platform. As we grow our portfolio of owned locations across the Denver metro, we're centralizing the patient experience so every clinic delivers the same fast, professional, on-brand front-desk service.



We're a remote-first, results-driven team. We move fast, we measure what matters, and we free our providers to do their best clinical work by taking the front-desk load off their plate.



## The Role

Our injectors and clinical staff are at their best with a patient in the chair — not chasing voi
s. Missed calls and slow lead follow-up are lost revenue. As a **Virtual Front Desk (VFD)**, you're the first voice and first responder for Refine Med Spa: answering calls and messages, converting inbound leads into booked appointments, and keeping calendars full and accurate.



This is a high-impact, revenue-facing role. In medical aesthetics, speed-to-lead and booking conversion directly drive the business — and you own them.



## What You'll Do

- Answer inbound phone calls, texts, and messages for 4–5 Refine locations promptly and professionally

- **Convert inbound leads into booked consultations and treatments** by calling and texting through our CRM — speed-to-lead is everything

- Book, confirm, reschedule, and manage appointments across multiple location calendars

- Reduce no-shows through proactive confirmation and reminder workflows

- Answer routine questions (location, hours, services, basic pricing, pre/post-care logistics)

- Capture accurate patient and lead information in our CRM/EMR

- Escalate clinical questions and anything outside your scope to the location owner/manager

- Hit defined targets: response time, lead-to-booking conversion, confirmation rate, no-show rate



## What We're Looking For

- 2+ years in a customer-service-facing role — Virtual Assistant, front desk, contact center, or similar

- **Healthcare, medical, dental, or aesthetics background strongly preferred** — you understand patient sensitivity and confidentiality

- **Proven sales or lead-conversion experience** — you can move a hesitant inbound lead to a booked appointment without being pushy

- Clear, neutral English — spoken and written. Phone presence matters.

- Availability during **US Mountain Time** business hours, following the **US holiday calendar**

- Independent, accountable problem-solver who performs with minimal supervision

- Reliable home office: fast wired internet, **backup connection and power**, quiet environment, quality headset



## Nice to Have

- Experience with med spa / aesthetics CRMs and EMRs

- Familiarity with **GoHighLevel**

- Prior remote work supporting a US healthcare or services company



## Compliance & Confidentiality

This role handles **protected health information (PHI)**. You will complete HIPAA training and sign a confidentiality agreement before touching any patient data. Strict adherence to our data-handling, privacy, and access protocols is a condition of employment.



## Logistics

- Full-time, fully remote (Philippines-based)

- US Mountain Time business hours; US holiday schedule

- Compensation: **$5/hr - $7/hr**



## How to Apply

Please submit:

2. **Your resume**

3. **An internet speed-test screenshot**

title: Civil Engineer Designer
description:
About Sera Engineered

Sera Engineered is a US-based civil engineering firm specializing in high-end residential and commercial land development. We provide a holistic suite of services including landscape architecture, utility design, stormwater management, surveying, and certified arborist work. We pride ourselves on precision, environmental stewardship, and design documents that set the industry standard for clarity and technical accuracy.



The Role

We are seeking an Advanced Civil Design Engineer to serve as a technical lead within our production team. This is not a "redline drafter" position. We are looking for an engineer who understands the "why" behind the "how." You will be responsible for the engineering logic of our site designs, ensuring that grading, drainage, and utilities are not only compliant with US codes but are optimized for construction and environmental preservation.



Core Responsibilities

Comprehensive Site Engineering: Develop full construction document sets from raw survey data, with a primary focus on grading, drainage, and utility infrastructure.



Stormwater Management (SWM) & Hydraulics: Perform complex hydrological calculations (Rational Method/TR-55) to size detention facilities, water quality structures, and conveyance systems.



Advanced Utility Coordination: Design and profile gravity sewer (10" SSWR) and pressurized water systems (8" W), proactively identifying and resolving vertical and horizontal conflicts (clash detection).



Environmental Integration: Incorporate arborist-led constraints into the civil design, specifically protecting Critical Root Zones (CRZ) and establishing Limits of Disturbance (LOD) to meet strict environmental regulations.



Quality Control (The CIV200 Standard): Take full ownership of the CIV200 sheet series. Ensure all plans reflect the Sera Engineered legend, keynotes, and aesthetic standards—delivering "permit-ready" sets that require minimal revision.



Proactive Problem Solving: Identify potential field issues (e.g., ADA slope non-compliance or utility crossings) during the design phase to prevent costly Change Orders.



Technical Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering (Licensed Engineer preferred).



Experience: 5+ years of experience in US-based land development or site civil design.



Software Mastery: Expert-level AutoCAD Civil 3D proficiency is mandatory (Surfaces, Pipe Networks, Pressure Networks, Alignments, and Data Shortcuts).



Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of US-based design standards, including ADA accessibility and local municipal drainage codes.



Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, capable of explaining complex engineering logic clearly.



Operational Compliance

Workflow: Must be disciplined in time-tracking via QuickBooks (using our "Project ID – Project Name" naming convention).



Payroll: Payments are processed exclusively through Globalization Partners (G-P).



Security: Must maintain a high Audit Point (AP) score (20 preferred) and possess a current, valid NBI Clearance.

description:
Position Title: Remote Bookkeeping Assistant

Location: Remote — Philippines-based candidates preferred

Work Type: Outsourced / Remote Contractor

Schedule: Part-time or full-time, depending on experience and workload

Time Zone Requirement: Must be able to work with some overlap during U.S. business hours

Experience Level: Intermediate U.S. bookkeeping experience required



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and experienced Remote Bookkeeping Assistant to support a U.S.-based bookkeeping and tax firm. This role is ideal for someone who already understands U.S. bookkeeping standards, knows how to review books carefully, and can assist with diagnostic reports and monthly financial reporting.



This is not an entry-level position. The right candidate must be comfortable working independently, following detailed procedures, identifying bookkeeping issues, and preparing clean, organized reports for review.



The candidate must also be comfortable working through a secure remote monitored server. Because we work with sensitive client financial information, the highest standards of confidentiality, professionalism, and data security are required.



Key Responsibilities



The Remote Bookkeeping Assistant will assist with:



Reviewing client books for accuracy and completeness.

Running and assisting with bookkeeping diagnostic reports.

Identifying common bookkeeping issues, including unreconciled accounts, duplicate transactions, incorrect categorizations, negative balances, missing transactions, and unusual account activity.

Assisting with monthly financial report preparation.

Preparing or supporting preparation of monthly reports such as:

Profit and Loss Statement

Balance Sheet

Cash Flow Statement

General Ledger review

Accounts Receivable Aging

Accounts Payable Aging

Bank and credit card reconciliation summaries

Transaction review reports

Supporting month-end close procedures.

Assisting with cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects.

Reviewing bank feeds, reconciliations, chart of accounts, and transaction coding.

Communicating questions clearly and professionally.

Following internal firm procedures and checklists.

Maintaining strict confidentiality of all client records and financial information.

Required Qualifications



Qualified candidates must have:



Intermediate experience with bookkeeping for U.S.-based businesses.

Experience working with monthly financial reports.

Experience assisting with or preparing diagnostic bookkeeping reports.

Strong understanding of bank and credit card reconciliations.

Familiarity with U.S. bookkeeping workflows, chart of accounts, expense categorization, and month-end review.

Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and unusual activity in financial records.

Strong attention to detail.

Good written English communication skills.

Ability to follow instructions, checklists, and firm procedures.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work environment.

Willingness to work through a secure, monitored remote server.

Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement and follow strict client data security procedures.

Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is preferred:



QuickBooks Online

QuickBooks Desktop

Xero

Excel or Google Sheets

Bank feed management

Month-end close process

Cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping

Financial statement review

Client bookkeeping diagnostics

U.S. small business bookkeeping

Bookkeeping for real estate, rentals, service businesses, or professional firms

Confidentiality and Security Requirements



This position involves access to confidential financial records. The selected candidate must uphold the highest level of client confidentiality.



The candidate must agree to:



Work only through the approved remote monitored server.

Not download, copy, photograph, screenshot, print, or share client information.

Keep all client information strictly confidential.

Use only approved systems and communication channels.

Follow all firm security policies.

Sign a confidentiality agreement before beginning work.



Any breach of confidentiality or data security will result in immediate termination.



Required Application Materials



Only complete applications from qualified candidates will be considered.



To apply, candidates must submit the following:



Resume or work history showing U.S. bookkeeping experience.

Example of a diagnostic bookkeeping report they have assisted with or prepared themselves.

Example of a monthly financial report package they have assisted with or prepared themselves.



Important: All examples must be fully redacted. Do not include client names, business names, addresses, bank account numbers, tax ID numbers, personal information, or confidential financial details. If you are not permitted to share prior client work, you may create a sample using demo data or fictional company data.



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is careful, organized, honest, and comfortable working behind the scenes to keep client books accurate and clean. We are looking for someone who does not simply enter transactions, but understands how to review books, spot problems, and support accurate monthly reporting.



You should be the kind of person who asks, “Does this make sense?” instead of just clicking “save.” Bookkeeping is not just data entry — it is financial housekeeping, and we need someone who keeps the house in order.



How to Apply



Please submit your application with the subject line:



Remote Bookkeeping Assistant — U.S. Bookkeeping Experience



Your application must include:



Resume or work history

Redacted diagnostic report sample

Redacted monthly financial report sample



Only candidates who meet the qualifications and submit all required materials will be considered.

title: ports Video Editor – Athletic Recruitment Reels Specialist (Experience Required)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE (PROJECT-BASED):

We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Sports Video Editor for project-based work to transform raw game footage into elite, standout recruitment reels. You will be given raw footage/game links and timestamps on a per-project basis, and your job is to craft short, high-energy reels that immediately capture the attention of college scouts and professional recruiters. 



This role is strictly for editors with a proven track record in sports highlights and recruitment videos. Generic video production portfolios will not be considered.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Review raw sports footage to identify the absolute best plays and athletic movements.

- Cut, pace, and sequence videos to build tension and highlight the athlete's primary strengths.

- Add clear visual identifiers (player spotlights, arrows, or circles) at the start of plays so recruiters know exactly who to watch.

- Incorporate clean, professional on-screen graphics (athlete bio, stats, contact info, and jersey number).

- Select high-energy, copyright-compliant background audio that matches the tempo of the sport.

- Deliver polished, high-definition final cuts optimized for scout viewing.



REQUIREMENTS:

- MUST have a portfolio featuring past sports highlight reels or recruitment videos.

- Deep understanding of sports pacing (Lacrosse and Field Hockey) and what recruiters look for.

- Advanced proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve).

- Ability to add clean graphics, text tracking, and isolation spotlights.

- Reliable communication and ability to hit project deadlines.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please reply with a brief introduction about your sports editing experience and a direct link to your portfolio/reel showcasing your BEST sports videos.
